Transport Documents

倉庫証券

An official document issued by a warehouse operator acknowledging the receipt and storage of specified goods, used as proof of ownership and for trade finance.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 倉庫証券?

In this glossary, 倉庫証券 refers to: An official document issued by a warehouse operator acknowledging the receipt and storage of specified goods, used as proof of ownership and for trade finance.

How is 倉庫証券 used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "銀行は商業融資申請の担保として倉庫証券を受け入れた。"

Why does 倉庫証券 matter in logistics?

倉庫証券 matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses 倉庫証券?

倉庫証券 is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does 倉庫証券 belong to?

In this glossary, 倉庫証券 is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An official document issued by a warehouse operator acknowledging the receipt and storage of specified goods, used as proof of ownership and for trade finance.

Operational example

The bank accepted the warehouse receipt as collateral for the trade finance loan application.
